phase: F2.1 coverage, empty states and local browser acceptance
scope: existing local dashboard; no new cloud, model, data-source or account permissions

automated_tests.data: fabricated fixtures and test keys only
covered: short history only in the latter half of a thirty-day window
distinct UTC record dates versus record count and valid observation count
pending, unscorable, calibrating and absent optional metrics
failed sync preserves previous data, source access and successful request
half-open midnight boundary excludes end-date records and gap markers

browser_acceptance.environment: independent loopback synthetic runner; temporary database; simulated client; no WHOOP network or Keychain access

scenarios.short-history: passed; 7/30-day switching, record coverage, latter-half-only insufficient data, same-date workouts, table, source details and Escape close
scenarios.pending: passed; records and dates remain visible, no numeric curve, simulated sync leaves scoring state intact
scenarios.unscorable: passed; explicit reason, no imputation and app-derived statistic label
scenarios.calibrating: passed; values excluded from statistics while original source value remains inspectable
scenarios.missing-metric: passed; recorded sleep without optional performance metric remains distinct from no records
scenarios.empty: passed; null dates, no observations, no invented wearing start or assumption of sync failure
scenarios.sync-failure: passed; old data visible, switching window keeps error, resume continues original request and clears error on success
scenarios.status-unavailable: passed; successful trend request does not erase status error; automatic retry clears it after status recovery

visual_checks.desktop_and_narrow_layout: passed; screenshots and DOM geometry on fabricated content
visual_checks.narrow_statistics_layout: adjusted to stack mean and comparison for readable labels
visual_checks.console: no unexpected errors observed; status-unavailable intentionally returns HTTP 503

live_local_check.health_output: none; only technical pass status returned

user_spot_check.source: user replied 一致 after being asked to compare recent dashboard records with WHOOP App locally
user_spot_check.scope: user-confirmed spot check, not exhaustive history reconciliation

not_run: complete record-by-record historical reconciliation against the user's WHOOP App
other browsers and complete accessibility or assistive-technology certification
real OAuth revocation, actual export mapping and production recovery
limitations: Captured record dates and counts are not wearing history or a guarantee of continuous coverage.
No records is not sufficient evidence of sync failure, non-wear or zero workout strain.
The approximate wearing-history clarification is not stored as personal data in this versionable evidence file.
